selection: Latest official Caffeine integration is the sole target. Current package sources take precedence over older integration examples; Canic bindings are extraction evidence, not the provider specification.

backend_reference.basis: Latest Mops publication 1.1.1 observed through the official registry; manifest and both backend source files match the pinned official source. Reference for the Rust integration, not an installed Motoko dependency.

qualification.implementation_scope: Service library includes durable upload, funding and gateway owners, bounded reply decoding, shared dispatch and explicit replicated gateway-query transport. Native and local PocketIC evidence does not qualify deployed provider completion, recovery, callbacks or settlement.

refresh_policy: Recheck official source and registry latest before provider implementation and qualification. Update exact pins, contract evidence and affected checks together; do not resolve moving latest tags at build time.
source_priority: September 2026 packages remain npm 1.1.2 and Mops 1.1.1. Target the current backend deletion-list vec blob shape; the April DFINITY vec text example is background, not a fallback. Actual deployed gateway interoperability remains to be qualified.
